whfc-vs-dover-athletic-2027-01-12.text: Official sources disagree about it. When we checked on 27 November 2026, the club's own fixture list showed the original Tuesday 1 December date as postponed without listing a new one, and Dover Athletic's calendar and its 4 November announcement still gave Tuesday 1 December.
